# Mon-portfolio

- Keep the portfolio in French and English; update both language variants together.
- Follow the existing dark editorial style with gold and burgundy accents, Cormorant Garamond headings, and Manrope body text.
- Keep the site responsive, keyboard accessible, semantic, and respectful of `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Edit text, projects, and technology data in `src/data/portfolio-data.ts`.
- Edit page structure in `src/page.ts` and brand marks in `src/ui/brand-icons.ts`.
- Edit interactions in the matching module under `src/features/`.
- Edit foundations in `src/styles/base.css`, content sections in `src/styles/sections.css`, and breakpoints/motion in `src/styles/responsive.css`.
- Keep `src/main.ts` as a small application entry point and `src/portfolio.css` as the stylesheet import index.
- Run `npm run build` after code changes.
